emails.subject: Reminder: Shared Office Equipment Is Shared (OS-2211)
emails.body:
Hi all,

A reminder that the red stapler at the Aquarium printer is shared office
equipment and belongs to the Aquarium printer.

It has been signed out to Marguerite (Finance) since 2019. If you are
Marguerite, please return it. If you know Marguerite, please let Office
Services know which floor she sits on, as we cannot find her in the directory.

Print jobs to print-07.hpcg.corp are queuing but not printing. This is known.

Thanks,
Office Services

beats.text: who is marguerite. i have worked here six years

normal.text: print-07 has 41 jobs queued and the oldest one is from 2019
